verdict.rationale: ADK provides some AI-native tooling — an 'Agents CLI' and coding-assistant integration for scaffolding/building agents via AI-enabled environments, plus a no-code 'Agent Config' builder — but this is about building agents with AI assistance, not a natural-language command interface for operating ADK itself day-to-day. missing for 10: direct evidence of natural-language commands driving ADK's own CLI/runtime operations (deploy, run, debug), independent hands-on confirmation of the Agents CLI's NL capabilities.
